newsitem.title: USA: HBO & Co names Gilbertson Exec VP and CFO.
newsitem.headline: HBO & Co names Gilbertson Exec VP and CFO.

text.p: HBO & Co said on Wednesday that it has promoted Jay Gilbertson to the position of executive vice president and chief financial officer.

Gilbertson, who joined HBO in 1988 as accounting manager for the company's hardware maintenance subsidiary, was promoted to corporate controller and chief accounting officer in 1991 and two years later was named chief financial officer, treasurer and assistant secretary.
As executive vice president, Gilbertson is in charge of all business development and acquisition-related activities for the company, as well as finance and accounting.
